curses.name: Get a Melon
curses.description: Acquire a whole melon, of any kind, before you request another challenge. Keep it with you for the rest of the game. If you have not found one within 30 minutes, the curse is cleared and you may carry on.

curses.name: Egg Partner
curses.description: Acquire a real egg before you request another challenge. It is now an official team member for the rest of the game. If it is ever left behind or visibly cracked, veto your current or next challenge immediately. If you have not found one within 30 minutes, the curse is cleared and you may carry on.

curses.name: Best Friends Forever
curses.description: On the next train you board, pick two other passengers. You may not get off until one of them does, and then only at the first interchange after they leave. If the train terminates first, you may get off there.

curses.name: Pub
curses.description: Before you request another challenge, go to a pub and buy one pint per team member. Any drink counts, and the team must finish them before leaving.

curses.name: Together Forever
curses.description: For 60 minutes, two team members must stay linked arm in arm. You may swap which two, but the linked pair must take part in every challenge. Ticket barriers, escalators and stairs are exempt.

curses.name: Long Neck
curses.description: Request your next challenge at least four interchanges along your declared line from your Anchor. If fewer than four remain, go to the last one. Ends when you next complete a challenge.

curses.name: Short Leash
curses.description: Request your next challenge at the first interchange along your declared line from your Anchor. Ends when you next complete a challenge.

curses.name: Blind Declaration
curses.description: Name a line now, publicly. You are bound to declare it when you next complete a challenge, so the Front you end up at must be served by it.

curses.name: Stated Intent
curses.description: Announce to all teams the interchange where you will request your next challenge. You must request it there. Ends when you next complete a challenge.

curses.name: Second Guess
curses.description: When you next complete a challenge, the line you declare may not be the one you arrived on. If your Front is served by only one line, the curse is void.

curses.name: Stairs Only
curses.description: For 60 minutes, use only stairs: no escalators and no lifts. Where a station has no stair route, or it is closed, wait three minutes and then use the escalator or lift.

curses.name: Scenic Route
curses.description: Before you request your next challenge, walk a full lap around the block the interchange sits on. Once only.

curses.name: Sightseeing
curses.description: Before you request your next challenge, visit every street entrance of the interchange you request it at. Where the interchange covers more than one station, do them all. Once only.

curses.name: Front Carriage
curses.description: For 120 minutes, board only the front carriage of any train. If it is full or closed, wait for the next train.

curses.name: Long Veto
curses.description: Your next veto period is doubled, whether you choose the veto or fail the challenge. Once only.

curses.name: No Way Out
curses.description: You may not veto the next pair of challenges you face. If you fail one instead, your veto period is doubled. Once only.

curses.name: Ambition
curses.description: You may only attempt the harder of the two challenges you are offered. Ends when you next complete a challenge.

curses.name: Double or Nothing
curses.description: You must complete both of the challenges you are offered. You are paid for the harder one only.

curses.name: Invisible Hand
curses.description: Every member keeps one hand behind their back while attempting a challenge. Ends when you next complete a challenge.

curses.name: Wrong Hand
curses.description: Every member uses only their non-dominant hand while attempting a challenge. Ends when you next complete a challenge.

curses.name: Vow of Silence
curses.description: Members may not speak to each other while attempting a challenge. Speaking to anyone else is fine. Lasts your next two challenges.

curses.name: Understudy
curses.description: Nominate one member now. In your next challenge, only they may do anything physical. The rest may advise, but not touch anything.

curses.name: Spectator
curses.description: Pick one of the other teams; they nominate one of your members. That person may not perform, advise or film during a challenge attempt, though they must stay with the team. Lasts your next two challenges.

curses.name: Witness
curses.description: For the rest of the game, send all other teams a photo of yourselves before you enter any station.

curses.name: Bouquet
curses.description: Acquire a bunch of flowers before you request another challenge. They must be visible in every piece of challenge evidence you submit for the rest of the game. If you have not found any within 30 minutes, the curse is cleared and you may carry on.

curses.name: Balloon
curses.description: Acquire an inflated balloon within 30 minutes and keep it with you for an hour after that. If it pops or escapes within that hour, veto your current or next challenge immediately. If you have not found one within 30 minutes, the curse is cleared.

curses.name: Rainy Day
curses.description: Acquire an umbrella within 30 minutes. For the hour after that, one member must hold it open whenever any part of the team is under open sky, and it may not strike anyone or anything. If you cannot find one within 30 minutes, the curse is cleared.

curses.name: Team Colours
curses.description: Every member must visibly wear or carry something in the colour of the line that brought you to your Anchor; buying something counts. Ends when you next complete a challenge. If you cannot manage it within 30 minutes, the curse is cleared.

curses.name: Dead Weight
curses.description: For 60 minutes, the team carries at least one extra kilogram by hand. It may not be set down while you are moving between interchanges.

curses.name: Hat Trick
curses.description: Before you request another challenge, every member must acquire headwear and wear it for the rest of the game. It may not be anything you already had with you. If you have not found enough within 30 minutes, the curse is cleared and you may carry on.

curses.name: Open Hand
curses.description: Immediately reveal to all teams how many coins you have and which powerups are in your hand.

curses.name: No Signal
curses.description: For 30 minutes you may not open a map or transport app, or look up a route by any other means. You may still use your phone for the game bot and for challenges.
